nodes.label: Input: nums (list of integers)
nodes.action: ctx['nums'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['n'] = len(ctx['nums']); ctx['pre'] = [0]; ctx['dp'] = {}; ctx['i'] = 0; ctx['j'] = 0

nodes.label: Find id = next index where pre[id] >= lb_need
Is id <= N?
nodes.logic: ctx['id'] is not None and ctx['id'] <= ctx['n']

verification.note: 确认 ILR 错误：OCR 流程图中计算前缀和的节点（pre[i]=pre[i]+pre[i-1]）在 ILR 中被丢失，pre 仅是 [0]+nums；且循环从 i=0 开始，节点 9/13 访问 nums[i-1]=nums[-1] 并污染 dp[0]。生成代码逐行忠实复刻了这两个缺陷。
verification.evidence: 按 ILR 逐句转写运行：solve([5,2,2])=3(期望1)、solve([1,2,3,4])=2(期望4)、solve([32])=2(期望1)；生成代码实跑在第一个断言 nums=[5,2,2] 期望 1 处 AssertionError。
